calls.head: Something has to give
calls.body: The Penguins are one of the league’s best for chance quality, but the Kings are one of the best at preventing dangerous shots. We’ll side with the Penguins.
calls.call: The Penguins’ chances are more dangerous than the league average (a 6.4% chance of scoring on the average shot) against the Kings.

surprises.head: Los Angeles brought the hits
surprises.body: Los Angeles’s hit score in the close stretches of the game was 178, against their usual 103 (100 is league average, adjusted for the arena’s scorer). A team strays this far about once every 50 games.

story.head: Malkin has three assists as the Penguins beat the Kings
paras: The first period was a wild one. Tommy Novak scored early in the period and again a little over three minutes later to put the Penguins up 2-0. Corey Perry got the Kings on the board less than five minutes later. Egor Chinakhov pushed the lead to 3-1 on the power play with 29 seconds left in the first. Alex Laferriere cut Pittsburgh’s lead to 3-2 on the power play early in the second, but that was as close as they got. Los Angeles had a goal taken off for offside late in the period. Sidney Crosby made it 4-2 for the Pens later in the period. He scored his second of the night into the empty net with a little over a minute left. Evgeni Malkin finished with three assists.

The score flatters the Penguins: the Kings had the better of the chances. Replay those chances a hundred times and the Kings win about six in ten. Murashov was the difference, stopping 26 of 28. It was Sergei Murashov’s first NHL win since Nov 16, 2025. Darcy Kuemper stopped 14 of 18 for the Kings. The loss ended Kuemper’s five-game winning streak. The Penguins improved to 6-9-2, seventh in the Metropolitan, while the Kings dropped to 5-8-2, seventh in the Pacific.

items.text: Sidney Crosby passed Marcel Dionne for sixth on the NHL’s all-time scoring list, with 1,773 points.
Evgeni Malkin passed Adam Oates for 20th on the NHL’s all-time scoring list, with 1,421 points.
The Penguins won for the first time in five games.
Sidney Crosby scored twice more against Los Angeles, and has six goals in seven games against them since 2023-24.
